title: Under Armour and Coach RAC Launch New Capsule
summary: Coach RAC and Under Armour are expanding their brand partnership with the launch of the Coach RAC Capsule. Designed for athletes who bring confidence, creativity and individuality to the game, the footwear, apparel, and accessories capsule reflects the energy and authenticity that have made RobertAnthony Cruz, also known as Coach RAC, one of baseball's most recognizable personalities.
body_markdown:
Drawing from colors and symbols that hold personal meaning for Coach RAC, the capsule features light blue, pink and yellow hues throughout. Yellow represents the revival of his baseball playing career, blue reflects his philosophy to flow like water and stay loose through the highs and lows of the game, and pink is a tribute to being a girl dad.


Additionally, the cleats’ plates feature a water-inspired design that reflects one of Coach RAC's core philosophies: staying calm, present and steady through the highs and lows of competition. As he often says, success isn't about speeding the game up, it's about finding your flow and enjoying every moment.
